sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the deterministic vocabulary error by renaming nltl:QuantityValueShape to a non-vocabulary shape IRI (for example, an urn IRI); do not mint local shape identifiers in the canonical nltl namespace. Preserve the required ship-level frameProfileType relationship, side applicability, alternative-specific load-case structure, comparison direction, and tolerance check. Add an explicit structural-member property constraint for nltl:midspanPlasticCollapseLoad as a QUDT QuantityValue with unit:KiloN, since it is a declared operand and is currently only referenced inside SPARQL.
